newsitem.title: RUSSIA: ATHLETICS-AFOLABI RUNS SEASON'S BEST 400 METRES.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-AFOLABI RUNS SEASON'S BEST 400 METRES.

text.p: Nigeria's Bisi Afolabi clocked the fastest women's 400 metres time of the season of 50.55 seconds on Sunday despite torrential rain at Moscow's IAAF Grand Prix.
She was followed home by compatriot Falilat Ogunkoya, who ran 50.79.

Britain's former Olympic champion Sally Gunnell, back in action after her injury at the Atlanta Games, clocked 55.30 to finish second in the women's 400 metres hurdles behind Tatyana Kereshchuk of Ukraine. Kereshchuk ran 54.96.
Gunnell improved on her performance in Rome last week where she was fifth in 55.52.
Russia's Irina Biryukova took the women's 1,500 in 4:05.70 on the flooded track.
